source_records.title: Bonfire Peaks
source_records.creator: Corey Martin; published by Draknek & Friends
source_records.transformation: Retains the surveyed relationship between 3D voxel stacks, box pushing/climbing, a rotatable view, and burning a carried box at a fire; replaces the commercial game's world, art, levels, exact movement rules, and input mapping with an original deterministic terraced garden and replay contract.
source_records.source_evidence: The supplied survey body describes a voxel-rendered box-pushing puzzle in which boxes are pushed and climbed on a 3D grid, the camera rotates, and a box is carried to a fire. The linked publisher material describes moving boxes within 3D dioramas to create a path to a bonfire.

original_assets.art: Procedural SVG isometric cells, crates, courier, foliage-colour surfaces, and hearth flame authored for this benchmark.
original_assets.third_party_runtime: None in the mechanic module; shared benchmark runtime only.
original_assets.license_note: No source code, images, audio, levels, or trademarked presentation from the cited game is bundled.

evidence_boundary: Automated browser/server/exported-verifier evidence is construction evidence. Human VNC calibration and computer-use-agent evaluation remain separate and are not claimed here.
